sources.title: gn64/M2M100_418M_CTranslate2 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: M2M100 418M CTranslate2 This is a CTranslate2-optimized quantized (int8) version of the M2M100 418M model, converted from the original Hugging Face Transformers format for faster inference. The original M2M100 model was developed by Facebook AI for many-to-many multilingual translation. License This model is released under the MIT License.
